source: INHERITED, NOT RE-VERIFIED. Carried from the orchestration-quality-control host capability matrix dated 2026-09-04 and its shipped .codex agent TOML files. The Claude row of that same matrix was found wrong on 2026-09-07, so treat these rows as a starting point and re-verify against Codex's own documentation before relying on a disclosure produced from them.

explicit_model.verified: Any model named in config.toml. Unset inherits from the parent, so it is always written.

reasoning_effort.verified: Documented per-agent key. Its scale is coarser than this plugin's, so effort_map folds xhigh and max onto high; the renderer discloses the fold rather than implying a level Codex never applied.

tool_allowlist.verified: No per-agent tool allowlist is documented; only mcp_servers scopes what an agent reaches. A tool grant therefore renders as an instruction plus an unenforced disclosure, never as a claim of isolation.

read_only_enforced.verified: sandbox_mode = "read-only" is enforced by the host sandbox rather than by instruction. This is the one capability Codex enforces more strongly than a tool allowlist can.

scoped_hooks.verified: No per-agent hook mechanism is documented.
